title: In-process sockets and websockets
intent: Boundary fixture: loopback connections inside the runtime are achievable, outbound TCP is not. Keeping the distinction visible matters more than the pass rate, because the two get conflated in marketing claims.
source: stackblitz-conformance: NodeJS http server and streams (websocket variant) (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Connect to a server inside the same runtime

knownLimits: Evidence must record whether the connection was loopback or outbound. Averaging them hides the real boundary.
